_comment: Washington 9% Competitive Housing Tax Credit Policies, Washington State Housing Finance Commission. The cover reads 'Last approved July 23rd, 2026 / Republished August 5th, 2026'; p.2 reads 'Republished 8/1/2025 with corrections', recorded not resolved. The companion washington-qap-2027.pdf is the 10-page QAP; the scoring lives here, in Chapter 6 Allocation Criteria (pp.43-65). Page numbers are PDF page indices; printed numbers run one lower. THREE GEOGRAPHIC POOLS, coded as a shared core (default track) plus add-on tracks king, metro and non_metro holding the pool-specific priority-population and location criteria. Hand-summed before loading. Core: 60 + 44 + 10 + 2 + 5 + 8 + 10 + 6 (At Risk or Historic) + 5 + 5 + 2 + 2 = 159. King +35 +7 = 201; Metro +25 +7 = 191; Non-Metro +25 +10 = 194. The loader matched each. NO TOTAL IS STATED; minimums are 160 King, 158 Metro and 154 Non-Metro (p.44). Summary-versus-body contradictions are recorded on 6.1 and 6.2.

track_totals.note: Shared core for all three pools, 159. No total stated.
King County add-on 42 (priority populations 35, location 7): pool maximum 201. Minimum 160.

groups.note: A DEVICE, not the document's rule. The rule is Eligible Tribal Area OR the other location criteria. A group can hold only one criterion per route, so this caps the sum of all of them at the better route's value: King 7 (2+2+1+1+1 against tribal 6), Metro 7 (2+2+1+1+1 against 5), Non-Metro 10 (tribal against 2+1).
